title: “Free trial” led to an unexpected charge
body: I signed up on September 25 for what was presented as a 7-day free trial. I saw no disclosure during sign-up that the trial itself would cost $4.99. Within about two hours, I canceled through Apple’s subscription settings because the app could not do what I needed. On September 29, I was charged $4.99 anyway. There is no cancellation button in the app’s settings, and tapping “Rate Us” did nothing when I tried it. There is a prominent Premium upgrade banner, but no equally clear way to manage or cancel the subscription within the app. My initial refund request through Apple was denied, and I am disputing that decision. This experience has left me feeling misled. The issue is not just $4.99—it is the lack of clear pricing and the time spent trying to resolve an unexpected charge. A trial presented as free should not come with a surprise fee. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this app. The developer needs to make trial pricing unmistakably clear, provide an accessible subscription-management option, and fix the nonworking “Rate Us” button.
